purpose: Pin down whether validator-1 local ingress underdelivery is a host/service latency problem under the item-219 safe topology before changing protocol code.

result.summary: Validator-1 ingress underdelivery is real under the safe p1 topology. Increasing independent writers from 32 to 64 did not restore target delivery.
result.decision: Do not pursue writer overprovisioning on validator-1 as the recovery path. The next path is a codified live topology that avoids validator-1 ingress while still verifying four-validator state convergence.

notes: This is a live delivery diagnostic, not a protocol optimization.
If 32 writer safe p1 cannot reach target on validator-1 but 64 writer safe p1 does, the full-run fix should be a codified writer-overprovisioned live benchmark topology, not pipeline depth.
If 64 writer safe p1 still cannot reach target, the next action is host/service remediation or an explicitly tagged fail-on-error pipeline canary, not consensus code churn.
